1	---
2	id: B_265
3	internalId: 2a81b19c-14fc-49d9-98c1-f7101fcd8e14
4	title: UI tests hit the Windows open-file limit while loading icons
5	status: ready for implementation
6	agents:
7	  - design/activity/card__2a81b19c-14fc-49d9-98c1-f7101fcd8e14.json
8	---
9	
10	## Problem
11	
12	UI test runs intermittently fail during dependency loading with `EMFILE: too many open files`, often naming an unrelated file under `app/node_modules/@mui/icons-material/`. Agents summarize this as "The grouped UI test runner hit Windows' open-file limit."
13	
14	Recorded failures affect `actions_no_mock.test.tsx`, `App.test.tsx`, and `action_popup.test.tsx`, including runs with only one test file selected. Suites fail before executing tests. Splitting runs or reducing test-worker concurrency does not reliably prevent the failure.
15	
16	## Evidence and likely cause
17	
18	`app/src/components/editor/source/markdown_source_undo_redo.tsx` imports `{ Redo, Undo }` from the root `@mui/icons-material` package. Its installed version, 9.2.0, has an index re-exporting **10,750 icon modules**. This barrel import exposes the entire icon catalogue to dependency loading despite using only two icons. [MUI recommends individual imports to avoid barrel-import overhead](https://mui.com/material-ui/guides/minimizing-bundle-size/).
19	
20	The import is reached through `MarkdownFormatToolbarControls` and the shared `MarkdownEditor`, including action prompt editors. It is a static import even when Source mode is inactive. Most other application icon imports already use individual module paths.
21	
22	The actions wrapper imports **21 grouped test files**; the UI project in `app/vite.config.ts` allows **2 workers**. These are separate from the 10,750 icon dependencies. The logs do not measure simultaneous open files or establish the runtime's exact descriptor limit. The barrel import is the leading suspected cause; an isolated before/after run is still needed to confirm it.
23	
24	`App.test.tsx` and `action_popup.test.tsx` already mock the root icon package and import Redo/Undo directly as a workaround. The UI setup also loads the actual MDXEditor package before applying its stub, adding dependency work.
25	
26	## Proposed solution
27	
28	Replace the production barrel import in `markdown_source_undo_redo.tsx` with:
29	
30	```ts
31	import Redo from '@mui/icons-material/Redo';
32	import Undo from '@mui/icons-material/Undo';
33	```
34	
35	Keep Source undo/redo behavior, grouped test organization, and worker settings unchanged. Review the two root-package mocks after the production change; remove them if they only work around this import and the targeted tests pass without them. Do not change the MDXEditor setup as part of this fix unless the remaining failure is traced to it.
36	
37	The affected toolbar and all shared editor consumers require the same icons and behavior. No service contracts, persistence formats, or desktop code need changes. Individual imports should also reduce development loading work without changing rendered icons.
38	
39	## Validation
40	
41	- On Windows, run `actions_no_mock.test.tsx` independently before and after the import change, then run it together with `App.test.tsx` and `action_popup.test.tsx`. Verify suites reach and complete their tests without `EMFILE`.
42	- Run existing focused Source undo/redo coverage to verify the buttons still invoke the Source controller and reflect undo/redo availability.
43	- Run the app linter. Use targeted test runs only; do not run the full suite for this fix.
44	- If `EMFILE` remains, measure concurrent file opens and trace the remaining dependency graph before proposing broader runner changes.
45	
46	No implementation change is included in this report.
47

entries.content:
Spec read. Code checked.

## Findings
- The barrel import (one import from the package root, which re-exports all 10,750 icons) is only in `app/src/components/editor/source/markdown_source_undo_redo.tsx:2`. No other production file imports the root `@mui/icons-material`.
- Two test files mock the root package only to swap in direct Redo/Undo imports, a workaround for this import:
  - `app/src/App.test.tsx:13-17`
  - `app/src/components/actions/run/popup/action_popup.test.tsx:49-53`
- Source undo/redo behaviour is already covered in `app/src/components/editor/markdown_editor_reliability.real.test.tsx` (lines 253, 255, 298, 316). That test clicks the buttons and checks they are disabled when nothing can be undone.

## Change Plan

**Block 1: production import**
- `markdown_source_undo_redo.tsx`: replace `import { Redo, Undo } from '@mui/icons-material'` with two direct imports, `@mui/icons-material/Redo` and `@mui/icons-material/Undo`. Behaviour stays the same.

**Block 2: remove workaround mocks**
- Delete the `vi.mock('@mui/icons-material', …)` block in `App.test.tsx` and in `action_popup.test.tsx`, plus the comment above the second one.
- This only happens if both files pass without the mocks in Block 3. If one fails, I keep that mock and report why.

**Block 3: validation (targeted runs only)**
- Run `actions_no_mock.test.tsx` alone. Then run it together with `App.test.tsx` and `action_popup.test.tsx`. Check for no `EMFILE` error.
  - Caveat: the spec asks for a before/after run. A "before" run would need the old import, so I'd run `actions_no_mock.test.tsx` once before Block 1 as the baseline.
- Run `markdown_editor_reliability.real.test.tsx` to check Source undo/redo still works.
- Run `npm run lint` in `app/`.
- If `EMFILE` still appears, I stop and report. No changes to the test runner or MDXEditor setup.

**Block 4: status**
- Set `status: ready` in the B_265 spec.

## Tests
- No new test planned. The existing Source undo/redo test already covers the behaviour. A test that only checks the import path would test an implementation detail, and AGENTS.md says to remove tests like that.
- Gap: nothing stops a future barrel import from coming back. One option is an ESLint `no-restricted-imports` rule for the root `@mui/icons-material` package. The spec doesn't ask for it, so I'm not adding it unless you say so.

## Tasks
I have no task-tracking tool in this session, so Blocks 1–4 above are the task list.

Waiting for your approval.

entries.content:
The `EMFILE` error is fixed. Before the change, `actions_no_mock.test.tsx` on its own crashed with `EMFILE` while opening `@mui/icons-material/SettingsPhoneOutlined.mjs`, before running any tests. After the change, it and the three other targeted files all load and run their tests. But 7 tests fail in two of those files, and I don't think my change caused them. B_265 is set to `status: ready`.

## What changed
- **`markdown_source_undo_redo.tsx`:** Redo and Undo are now imported directly from `@mui/icons-material/Redo` and `@mui/icons-material/Undo`, instead of from the package root that pulls in the whole icon set.
- **Test mocks:** I removed the root-package icon mock from `App.test.tsx` and from `action_popup.test.tsx`, since it only worked around the old import.

## Test results
I ran `actions_no_mock.test.tsx`, `App.test.tsx`, `action_popup.test.tsx` and `markdown_editor_reliability.real.test.tsx` together: 476 passed, 7 failed, no `EMFILE`. Lint is clean.
- **Source undo/redo:** `markdown_editor_reliability.real.test.tsx` passes.
- **`App.test.tsx`:** passes without the mock.

## The 7 failing tests
Before the fix, `actions_no_mock.test.tsx` crashed before any test ran, so these 4 failures there couldn't show up:
- **`action_conversation_chat_integration.grouped.test.tsx`:**
  - "renders streamed output and live context usage from its conversation selector"
  - "shows and acknowledges selected history while hidden live updates accumulate"
  - The text never appears; the log also shows `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'kind')` in `actionContextIdentity` (`app/src/data/action_context.ts:69`).
- **`action_editor.grouped.test.tsx`:** "shows the validation error while an invalid edit is staged". `saveDefinition` is called once when the test expects zero calls.
- **`action_entry_points.grouped.test.tsx`:** "switches actions through the universal selector without related-action shortcuts". The button shows `aria-pressed="false"` where the test expects `"true"`.

`action_popup.test.tsx` has 3 more failures. I put its mock back temporarily, reran, and the same 3 failed, so removing the mock didn't cause them:
- "uses host defaults and custom profiles in action selectors"
- "omits retained shared permission mode when custom agent runs"
- "keeps unavailable saved configuration visible without overwriting persistence"

None of the 7 involve icons. They look tied to the other uncommitted agent-catalog and action-settings work in the worktree, but I haven't confirmed that.

I didn't add an ESLint rule to block root-package icon imports, since the spec doesn't ask for it. The four test files took about 115 seconds to run.

Should I look into and fix these 7 failures now, or leave them for separate work?
